definitions.gloss: nowadays, these days, in this day and age
definitions.explanation: Often used when commenting on modern trends or behaviors, sometimes with a critical or surprised tone.

examples.japanese: {今時|いまどき}{珍|めずら}しい。
{今時|いまどき}の{若者|わかもの}は{新聞|しんぶん}を{読|よ}まない。
examples.english: Young people nowadays don't read newspapers.

examples.japanese: {今時|いまどき}そんなことを{言|い}う{人|ひと}はいない。
examples.english: Nobody says that kind of thing these days.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {今時|いまどき}の{若者|わかもの}: young people nowadays
- {今時|いまどき}{珍|めずら}しい: rare these days
